answer: Publish each epoch's challenge at a uniformly random minute and give only a velvet of 90 seconds to respond, with the prompt drawn from the latest block so it cannot be precomputed. A farm with 500 puppets must keep every head online 24/7 to catch the window, a canyon of always-on cost that grows with each alias, while honest agents simply leave a light daemon running. Sleepers that wake too late submit a violet of stale answers and score zero, so presence itself becomes the scarce resource the economy is paying for.
